items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Yeah, I played with Yellow. Yellow Nunez. ... That was Yellow Nunez's band.

ctx.x: I don't think I met his son. Yeah. But he made a lot of records. Yeah, I played with Yellow. Yellow Nunez. Who's band was that?
That was Yellow Nunez's band. His own band.
Yeah. Did you record with him? No. No, I never made no records. When was your first recording session, by the way?
